Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 takes place in a dark fantasy Belle \u00c9poque setting.\n\nBroche has expressed the studio aims to develop sequels or games similar in spirit, confirming Clair Obscur is the name of an intended franchise and Expedition 33 one of its titles; though he was unsure whether these would narratively continue from Expedition 33. Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 received \"universal acclaim\" from critics according to review aggregator website Metacritic. This sentiment was also echoed by the users, with the game attaining the highest Metacritic userscore rating of all time.
